data.name: Holiday Inn Huatulco by IHG
data.address: Blvd. Benito Juárez 604-Sector "A, 70987 Bahía de Santa Cruz Huatulco, Oax., Mexico
data.description:
This down-to-earth hotel is 9 km from Bahías de Huatulco International Airport and 18 km from Parque Nacional Huatulco.
Colorful, modern rooms, some with balconies, have air-conditioning and tile floors, as well as free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Suites add minifridges and dining tables. Room service is available.
Parking is complimentary. There's an airy restaurant, a bar and a lounge. Other amenities include a gym and an outdoor pool.
